_comment: Maps each ground-truth file to the source PDF it was transcribed from.
Ground truth lives in solution/<id>.md -- Markdown so the tables render.
These were transcribed by reading the rendered pages, NOT copied from model
output. Correct them where you disagree; the comparison is only as
trustworthy as these files.
Table markup is normalised before scoring, so pipe tables here and HTML

tables from the model score identically.
inside a cell counts as a
line break, matching a real newline in an HTML cell.
sol003 is a handwritten scan; its handwritten values are best-effort and
should be verified before relying on its score.
sol007 is a noisy scan: its number, date and totals band are printed over a
stamp. sol010's page image is only 1125x1533, so its footer fine print is
best-effort and should be verified before relying on its score.
doc_types is a LIST because a document is regularly more than one type at
once: six of these ten head themselves with a slash -- a receipt AND a tax
invoice, a credit note AND a tax invoice. The extraction form is the UNION
of the forms for the types listed here, so a page that is both answers for
both. The codes are normalise.document_types' vocabulary, and the first is
the one the file is named and grouped under.
THIS LIST OVERRULES THE PAGE. The classifier reads the printed heading; a
person reads the document. Where the two disagree, edit here. sol001 is the
standing example: it prints ใบแจ้งหนี้ in Thai and STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT in
English, so the classifier reports both, and it is filed as a statement of
account. Drop "INVOICE" from its list to make that reading exclusive.
aliases are the filenames these PDFs shipped under before 2026-08-31, kept
so an upload of an original still resolves by name (rule 3). Contents are
unchanged, so the sha256 rule matches them either way.
